info.description: Every operation of the app, as the web app and agents call them. POST the operation's input to its path; the answer is an envelope whose outcome sets the status. Authenticate with a bearer token: a personal API token, a connected app's token or an agent's token.

post.description: List a space's decisions, newest first: what was chosen, why, and where. Superseded ones are left out unless includeSuperseded.

parameters.description: The workspace the operation acts in, by id or slug. A target in another workspace is not found.
parameters.name: workspace

includeSuperseded.description: Include decisions that were later replaced.

limit.description: How many, newest first (default 50, at most 200).
